patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Saleor and Salesforce Commerce Cloud share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Saleor only if your buying job matches “Headless GraphQL commerce — OSS self-host free; Cloud Select $1599/mo, Volume $3999/mo, En” rather than Salesforce Commerce Cloud's shape. Choose Salesforce Commerce Cloud only if your buying job matches “Salesforce B2C Commerce (ex-Demandware) — Growth/Plus/Premium are GMV-percent quote only; ” rather than Saleor's shape. Workflow advantage: Saleor leans shared coverage; Salesforce Commerce Cloud leans wholesale-b2b, catalog-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Saleor and Salesforce Commerce Cloud share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Saleor is Headless GraphQL commerce — OSS self-host free; Cloud Select $1599/mo, Volume $3999/mo, Enterprise quote. Forever Free is non-commercial onl; Salesforce Commerce Cloud is Salesforce B2C Commerce (ex-Demandware) — Growth/Plus/Premium are GMV-percent quote only; enterprise SaaS landscape, not an SMB Shopify subs.
- Workflow coverage skew: Saleor-leaning — vs Salesforce Commerce Cloud-leaning wholesale-b2b, catalog-management.
- Researched limits: Saleor — Cloud Select floor ($1599/mo) is high versus WooCommerce hosting TCO; Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Pricing is opaque GMV-% — hard to compare without a Salesforce worksheet.

Limitations — Saleor: Cloud Select floor ($1599/mo) is high versus WooCommerce hosting TCO; Forever Free Cloud is non-commercial — not a production merchant free plan; Salesforce Commerce Cloud: Pricing is opaque GMV-% — hard to compare without a Salesforce worksheet; Implementation is a multi-month SI programme, not a weekend theme install.

Poor-fit cases: Saleor is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Cloud Select floor ($1599/mo) is high versus WooCommerce hosting TCO · Salesforce Commerce Cloud is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Pricing is opaque GMV-% — hard to compare without a Salesforce worksheet · Avoid Saleor if you actually need Salesforce Commerce Cloud's motion (Salesforce B2C Commerce (ex-Demandware) — Growth/Plus/Premium are GMV-percent qu)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
